Electricity bills in Kerala continue to rise, and homeowners are actively searching for smarter ways to reduce monthly expenses. One solution that is gaining rapid popularity is installing a [solar system for homes in Kottayam](https://risingsunsolar.in/).


With abundant sunlight, government subsidies, and long-term savings, rooftop solar has become one of the most practical investments for homeowners across Kottayam. Whether you own an independent house, villa, or residential property, solar energy can significantly reduce your dependence on the grid while increasing the value of your property.


In this guide, we explain the pricing, available options, expected savings, and factors to consider before installing a solar system for homes in Kottayam.


## Why More Homeowners in Kottayam Are Choosing Solar


Kottayam enjoys favorable weather conditions for solar power generation throughout the year. Combined with rising electricity tariffs and government incentives, rooftop solar offers an attractive return on investment[.](https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in) Kerala households can also benefit from the PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar subsidy scheme, which helps reduce the initial installation cost.


The biggest reason homeowners switch to solar is simple:


**Lower electricity bills for the next 20–25 years.**


Instead of paying increasing power charges every month, homeowners can generate their own electricity and save thousands of rupees annually.


## Types of Solar Systems for Homes in Kottayam


### 1. On-Grid Solar System


This is the most popular option for residential properties.


Benefits include:


* 
Lower installation cost

* 
Net metering facility

* 
No battery maintenance

* 
Maximum return on investment



Excess electricity generated during the day is exported to the grid and adjusted against your electricity bill.


### 2. Hybrid Solar System


Hybrid systems combine solar panels with battery backup.


Suitable for:


* 
Areas with frequent power cuts

* 
Homes requiring backup power

* 
Families seeking energy independence



### 3. Off-Grid Solar System


These systems operate completely independent of the electricity grid.


Best suited for:


* 
Remote locations

* 
Farmhouses

* 
Areas with limited grid connectivity

## Government Subsidy for Residential Solar


Homeowners installing a rooftop solar system for homes in Kottayam can benefit from the PM Surya Ghar subsidy program.


Current subsidy structure includes:


* 
1 kW: Up to ₹30,000 subsidy

* 
2 kW: Up to ₹60,000 subsidy

* 
3 kW and above: Up to ₹78,000 subsidy



The subsidy significantly reduces the overall investment cost and improves ROI.


## How Much Can You Save?


The savings depend on:


* 
Monthly electricity consumption

* 
Solar system capacity

* 
Roof orientation

* 
Weather conditions



A properly designed 5 kW solar system can generate approximately 18–22 units of electricity per day under favorable conditions. Most homeowners recover their investment within 4–6 years, while the system continues generating savings for decades.
